 Home Terence Crawford Floyd Mayweather Terence Crawford attempts to hijack Floyd Mayweather’s comeback fight with 160lb offer
 Jamie Theodosi Wed 4 November 2026 15:00 Follow us on Google Discover Terence Crawford is seemingly open to come back to boxing for one last fight, despite having retired following his blockbuster win against Canelo Alvarez. 
 This Wednesday morning, Terence Crawford took to social media to declare his interest in returning to boxing for one last fight, despite retiring last year after his undisputed super middleweight title win over Canelo Alvarez.
 Ever since his retirement, the 42-0 pound-for-pound great has maintained that he will never return to the sport, despite Dana White believing he could tempt Crawford out of retirement .
 The 39-year-old has seemingly changed his mind, though, and he has turned his attention to Ryan Garcia , who currently holds the WBC welterweight world title.
 Change my mind: Terence Crawford is the best fighter of his era
 Is anyone better than 'Bud'? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below.
 Terence Crawford’s career accomplishments. Image credit: Chris Unger/TKO Worldwide LLC via Getty Images Comment Like or Comment Have your say Sign-in now for free Crawford turns attention to Ryan Garcia and Gervonta Davis as he calls for one more fight
 In a post on X, ‘Bud’ Crawford claimed, “Maybe one more!” relating to his boxing career, despite his previous claims. That led to the former undisputed super middleweight champion attempting to figure out who he could come back and fight. Initially, Crawford took aim at Gervonta Davis, saying that if they were the same weight he would come back and fight him.
 “I wish I was at 135lbs, I’ll stop Tank. He talks too much, but be picking and choosing. But we know he would come up with excuses like he does with Shakur (Stevenson),” Crawford said. ‘Tank’ Davis hasn’t fought since March 2025 when he drew against Lamont Roach Jr. and since then, he has been facing several legal issues regarding alleged domestic violence.
 With it extremely unlikely that Crawford and Davis could come to terms regarding a weight to fight at, that has led the 39-year-old to turn his attention to ‘King’ Garcia. “What’s up Ryan Garcia, 160lbs?” Crawford continued. Garcia’s last few fights have been at 147lbs, meaning 160lbs would be a significant move up in weight for him.
 What’s up @RyanGarcia 160?
— Terence Crawford (@terencecrawford) November 4, 2026 View Tweet Having said that, throughout his career, ‘Bud’ fought between 147-168lbs, meaning his offer to cut back down to 160lbs is actually a fair offer. Despite that, Garcia has been in talks with Floyd Mayweather for a potential fight, with ‘Money’ Mayweather continuing his attempt to make a return.
 “My bad Ryan Garcia, you got Mayweather to focus on, I forgot,” Crawford seemingly joked as he continued his callouts.
 Will Ryan Garcia and Floyd Mayweather fight?
 Earlier this week, Mayweather announced another exhibition fight , claiming that it will be a ‘tune-up’ for a fight against ‘King’ Garcia. And although the 28-year-old is adamant that talks have begun, fans are not convinced the fight will come together, pointing towards Mayweather’s recent history of canceling fights.
 Mayweather’s latest announcement comes after an extremely turbulent year of planned fights, with his proposed exhibitions against Mike Zambidis, Mike Tyson and Manny Pacquiao having yet to come to fruition. His scheduled fight against Zambidis earlier this year failed to materialize amid legal complications, while his fights against Pacquiao and Tyson were postponed indefinitely. With ‘Money’ continuing to hint at a fight against Garcia, questions remain over whether the former five-weight world champion can actually make his plans a reality.
